prompt: Why is one voucher not enough for what Sienna wants?
promptZh: 為什麼一張抵用券不足以達成 Sienna 的安排？

options.text: It covers only one of the two people who need seats.
options.zh: 它只能抵用兩人所需座位中的一席。
options.whyZh: Sienna 與 Jules 都需要座位，但公告說一張券只抵一席。

options.text: The voucher cannot be used for a captioned film.
options.zh: 抵用券不能用於有字幕的電影。
options.whyZh: 公告未排除有字幕的場次。

options.text: The voucher is valid only when a companion buys a seat at the door.
options.zh: 同行者必須在現場買票，抵用券才有效。
options.whyZh: 公告未設這種限制；抵用券要在中午前上網兌換。

options.text: The captioned show had only one seat left at 10.
options.zh: 有字幕的場次上午十點時只剩一席。
options.whyZh: Sienna 說網站當時顯示四席。

explanationZh: Sienna 與 Jules 都需要座位，但公告說一張券只抵一席。
evidence:
Document 1 · Cinema notice
Clover Cinema | Wednesday screenings
The 6:20 screening has open captions. The 8:10 screening does not. Doors open fifteen minutes before each screening.
A voucher covers one seat, not a companion’s seat. Redeem it online before noon on the day of the screening. You can also buy regular seats online before noon. Any seat still available after noon may be bought at the door at the regular price. Unused vouchers can be moved to a later date by emailing the office; the box office cannot do this.

Document 2 · Message from Sienna
To: Jules
I can get there at 6:10. Please choose the screening with captions. I received only one voucher, but we both need seats. The website showed four seats left at 10 this morning. Could you take care of the tickets before lunch? If you can only get one seat, don’t redeem the voucher yet. I’d rather move it to next Wednesday than go alone.
